## Summary

Sabiote is a municipality located in the province of Jaén, within the autonomous community of Andalusia, Spain. The town is situated in the northeastern part of La Loma, bordering the municipalities of Úbeda, Torreperogil, Santisteban del Puerto, and Navas de San Juan. The town is part of the larger region of Andalusia, known for its rich cultural heritage, natural beauty, and gastronomy.
